summary: Authorize native landing admission and reserve existing host headroom

replay.detail: Existing membership classes and custody records remain readable; granted custody is retained.

schema.detail: Finite host policy adds landing.allowedActors, landing.memoryBytes and landing.heavyIoSlots with empty/zero defaults. mission-run.created adds optional immutable initiating_principal from the authenticated serving boundary. Shell execution and terminal receipts add optional typed refusal codes and receipt refusal reasons.

rules.detail: Landing requires host-authorized native ownership or the recorded authenticated initiating principal, never requester attribution, and strict FIFO. System descendants inherit their original principal; an authenticated retry records its new principal. Ordinary work and seats cannot consume unused landing headroom; total capacity does not grow. Protected headroom is a minimum, not a Landing ceiling; an authorized Landing backlog can starve check/agent.

compatibility.detail: An unconfigured host visibly refuses landing with unauthorized-landing. Historical roots and legacy client-v0 mission.start roots have no verified principal and cannot lend Landing authority. Ordinary admission retains its existing capacity when reservations are zero. Declared priority remains metadata.

downtime.detail: No automatic restart or host activation.

manual.detail: Deploy the supporting daemon before setting deny-unknown-fields host keys. Configure exact authorized actor subjects and a carve-out of existing totals. Restart a historical factory intake once from the authenticated Factory Manager seat with native fractal missions start.

recovery.detail: Existing generation fencing and confirmed-retirement custody rules remain unchanged.
